name: FFS_RESOURCE_LOCATION
description: Contains locations created on the resource level or assigned to resources.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a resource a location is assigned for.

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a location which is assigned for a resource.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Type of location assignment. Available values: 'assigned', 'start', 'end', 'home'.

columns.name: WEEKDAYS
columns.description: Bit mask which defines the days of week when the location assignment is active. Values: 1 - Sun, 2 - Mon, 4 - Tue, 8 - Wed, 16 - Thu, 32 - Fri, 64 - Sun.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Indicates date since when location assignment is active.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Indicates date until which location assignment is active.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
